spans.text: Go on. The time has come to rewrite our fate.
ARGHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!
Bang—
The memento from UMP40 dug painfully into her palm as UMP45 gripped it tight while heading for the exit.
The main door wasn't far off, and if she could leave through there, she would survive. That was her only hope.
I thought...there wouldn't be any more survivors.
A familiar figure leaned against the wall, seemingly in a great deal of pain. She was blocking the only passage that UMP45 could take to the main gate.
This was the leader of Squad 7, a Doll that UMP45 had seen before — M16.
You recognize me?
What do you think?
I don't know. There's S.F. everywhere. There are too many enemies and I don't even know what happened.
No, the truth was that she knew very well what had happened.
This was the first time UMP45 had ever lied, but it could not feel any more natural to her.
Well, I'm in a pretty sorry state myself. So, can you open this door, member of Support Team 14?
I believe I can.
45 walked up to the door terminal. UMP40 had told her that she could open it by forcing a connection.
Hopefully, it hadn't been locked down yet.
After a fairly brief procedure, the door opened with some ear-splitting noise.
Alright, ready to go?
Thanks, I guess I was luck...
M16 suddenly stopped talking, and her gaze slowly turned ice-cold.
It was just a small detail, but it was definitely unnatural.
There was no way of explaining it.
Say, where's that Doll you're always following around? Her name is UMP40, right?
UMP45 squeezed the dog tags in her hand tightly and answered in a calm, even tone.
She died.
So why isn't there even a single scratch on you?
UMP45 paused for less than a second, but that was all the answer M16 needed.
Both their guns fired at once, and as bullets spewed forth, both Dolls dove for cover.
UMP45 inspected her body. She had taken several hits, but she could still move.
Her radio kept me from taking a critical wound.
You're always saving me, 40.
The answer is simple, then. It was you, wasn't it?
The alarms, the Sangvis forces, the escape of the target...
Come out and surrender. As a comrade, I'll make it quick and clean.
Yes, she's completely right.
Yes, she ought to take responsibility for this.
Yes, she should have died.
Don't even try to put up a fight. I'm sure you know what your odds are, given your specs.
The only thing I know...is "what's right". That's all...
But I need to make it out of here today, no matter what.
I must survive, no matter the cost!
Bangbangbang—
Bangbangbang—
UMP45 dove from one piece of cover to another, clearly struggling. The onslaught of M16's bullets left no room for her to return fire.
Worse, she had already expended most of her ammunition in the previous battle.
She needed to move. M16 was right — given UMP45's specs, she stood no chance at all in a fight against the elite.
All she could do was rely on her speed to shake off this veteran Doll.
Getting past her was impossible, so her only option was to return to the base and find another exit.
Come to your senses! There's no way you can escape!
No wonder you made it. You're right, there's an overwhelming difference between us.
But I must live. I, too, have a reason to survive!
You can go to hell with your reason, traitor!
This should work!
Urgh! No, I have to... I have to...
You know who I am?
Thank goodness! Guys! I pulled 45's mind back!
Having regained consciousness, UMP45 finds herself lying on the ground. The other members of Squad 404 have their backs to her as they keep a lookout.
She can't see any S.F. around, nor can she hear M16's irritating voice.
Looks like there's nothing left for me to do.
Ah, the hag's awake!
You did that on purpose, didn't you?!
Passing out before the fighting starts and conveniently "waking up" once the fighting's done?
Well, still kicking, are we?
Taking the hand offered by her teammate, UMP45 pulls herself up to her feet.
I had a nightmare that was interrupted halfway.
How are things?
After we took down that batch of S.F., 9 did a scan and picked up some traces of Intruder.
We suspect she was used by M16 as a relay node for the hacking attack against you.
Yes...we tried to give chase, but she seemed very familiar with the terrain here. Plus, you were in a bad state, so we didn't press on with the pursuit.
That said, I can still follow her signal. Want to go after her?
M16's little trick might be a disaster waiting to happen. We can't just ignore it.
Plus, that Sangvis ringleader might know something about DEFY.
I knew you'd say that.
Still, you might get hacked again if you got close to Intruder, 45...
She really is obsessed, isn't she? If only she could direct that passion onto her sister.
After all, you ARE the only one here with a command module. Taking you out would solve a problem for S.F. with a minimal expenditure of effort.
That's exactly her style.
Thank you for introducing your old partner in such detail. However, we really need to move now.
...Let's go.
